Cook2017.type: Two-page LPSC XLVIII abstract 2478, preliminary conference report, not final 2018 article.
authors: New Horizons Surface Composition Theme Team
Cook2017.observations: 2015-07-14 encounter; two Nix LEISA scans at publisher approximate ranges 60,000/162,000 km. Exact scan time/product crosswalk open.
Cook2017.measurement: 1.5/2.0 micron water-ice bands; 1.65 micron crystalline signature and additional approximately 2.2 micron feature. Nix approximately 130 detector pixels in closest scan, source estimate not a new raster calculation.
Cook2017.model: Hapke intimate mixtures use amorphous/crystalline water-ice grain sizes and tholin components, assume 50 K; fitted mixtures, temperature and grain sizes are not direct local composition/temperature measurements. NH3-water mixture or other ammoniated carrier proposed, not unique chemistry. Ceres comparison does not authorize Ceres terrain reuse.
Cook2017.limits: Noise-pattern removal, motion correction and extraction matter; reported little band-depth variation does not establish uniform centimetre-scale terrain or assign spectra to native MVIC pixels. Full Cook2018 DOI10.1016/j.icarus.2018.05.024 remains open; publisher web access returned internal error, no final-paper hash or licence invented.

Holler2025.type: Two-page conference abstract 7028, LPI contribution3059; not asserted peer-reviewed final paper. Exact publication day remains unknown.
Holler2025.measurement: Aperture photometry of unresolved Nix/Hydra in short-wavelength images, nearby-background correction for Pluto/Charon contamination. Only one image per filter/date due to dither issue. Not present in long-wavelength images; Styx/Kerberos undetectable in this observation setup, not absence.
Holler2025.interpretation: Comparison to DiSCo-TNO program2418 spectral classes and water-rich Haumea family is closest to water-rich family but discrepant at shorter wavelengths; similarities are not identity or local fractions. Red material and primordial-impact-layer origins are hypotheses, not direct history, chemistry or dated local terrain. No other-body map adopted.
Holler2025.limits: These 0.7–1.4 micron measurements do not resolve geography, uniquely identify chemistry or calibrate visible colour/native MVIC/observer scene. MAST exposure/extraction/calibration crosswalk and final publication remain open.
Holler2025.credit: NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope; STScI operated by AURA under NASA contract NAS5-03127; programs1658/2418.
